text:
Harper: emergency PSA: Pixel the ferret has discovered the office keyboard and now believes its a bed. photo: https://img.internal/pixel-keyboard-nap.jpg :keyboard: :ferret: 
Jon: omg his little snoot in the enter key. did he hit send on anything? 
Sofia: he typed 'ssss' and a string of random emojis into #general earlier, i thought it was a bug. :joy: 
Harper: confirmed: five minutes of productivity lost to cuddle retrieval. also one rogue semicolon added to a doc. 
Jon: vote: make him honorary QA? catches stray semicolons and naps on keyboards. :ballot_box: 
Sofia: absolute yes. also who can fetch the tiny scarf he stole from my desk? 
Harper: scarf was reclaimed after bribing with a paperclip. 
ops-bot: Reminder: please ensure keyboards are cleared when pets are in common areas and register any office animals with People Ops. :memo: 
Jon: photo request: GIF of ferret retract-and-pounce? 
Harper: GIF: https://img.internal/pixel-pounce.gif has dramatic zoom 
Sofia: top-tier mischief. adding to my "meeting mood" folder. 
Jon: also, Pixel has a habit of hiding pens inside laptop bags. recommend label: "Not a chew toy." 
Harper: new procedure: secure writing instruments in drawer B (under the cactus). 
Sofia: reaction: :heart: (to the first pic) 
Harper: Pixel sends a muffled squeak of apology and a tiny pencil as restitution. 
ops-bot: Poll created: "Bring a pet + a workspace prop to show-and-tell next Friday?" Options: Yes / No / Virtual only. 
Jon: voted Yes. 
Sofia: voted Virtual only (my cat eats chargers). 
Harper: voted Yes. 
Sofia: final note: Pixel demands more belly rubs and will not accept meeting invites without snacks.
